stories.summary: Presley Gerber’s Hollywood Hills home has hit the market for $3.59 million, less than two months after the model’s death at age 27.
stories.zh_title: 已故普雷斯利·格伯 (Presley Gerber) 去世 2 個月後，其位於好萊塢山的住宅以 360 萬美元掛牌出售
stories.zh_summary: 普雷斯利·格伯 (Presley Gerber) 在好萊塢山的住宅以 359 萬美元的價格掛牌出售，距離這位模特兒 27 歲去世後不到兩個月。

stories.title: Tech German software major SAP is reportedly weighing cutting at least 10,000 jobs in AI push
stories.summary: SAP is weighing cuts of at least 10,000 jobs as it reshapes its software business around AI, Bloomberg reported.
stories.zh_title: 據報道，德國軟體巨頭 SAP 正考慮在人工智慧推動方面裁員至少 1 萬人
stories.zh_summary: 根據彭博社報道，SAP 正在考慮裁員至少 10,000 人，以圍繞人工智慧重塑其軟體業務。

stories.title: A New Breed of Chip Runs AI Models Using Waves of Light
stories.summary: German company Q.ANT is trying to cut the amount of energy required to run AI models by using light to perform the toughest calculations.
stories.zh_title: 一種新型晶片利用光波運行人工智慧模型
stories.zh_summary: 德國公司 Q.ANT 正試圖透過使用光來執行最困難的計算來減少運行人工智慧模型所需的能量。

stories.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
stories.summary: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.
stories.zh_title: 英偉達暫停向東南亞供應晶片

stories.title: Meta Refused to Share Muse for Testing, UK Financial Watchdog Complains
stories.summary: The FCA warned against “another force of attack” from agents after the company declined a request to work on joint testing ahead of rolling out its personal agent in the UK on Tuesday.
stories.zh_title: 英國金融監理機構抱怨 Meta 拒絕分享 Muse 進行測試
stories.zh_summary: FCA 警告稱，該公司週二在英國推出其個人代理之前拒絕了進行聯合測試的請求，因此對來自代理的「另一股攻擊力量」發出警告。

stories.title: Semiconductor chips are the new oil. Here's why
stories.summary: Semiconductor exports overtook oil and gas for the first time in 2026, as the AI boom fueled chip demand.
stories.zh_title: 半導體晶片是新的石油。這就是為什麼
stories.zh_summary: 隨著人工智慧的繁榮刺激了晶片需求，半導體出口在 2026 年首次超過石油和天然氣。

stories.title: Buyer beware? Nvidia's volatile swings expose risks of single-stock ETFs

stories.zh_summary: ETF Action 創始合夥人 Mike Akins 和 GraniteShares 執行長 Will Rhind 對 Nvidia 的大幅虧損和最近的捲土重來做出了反應。

stories.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue
stories.summary: On the same day that Anthropic entered the public market, a painstakingly human video game became one of most successful entertainment launches of all time.

stories.zh_summary: 在 Anthropic 進入公開市場的同一天，一款精心設計的人類電玩遊戲成為有史以來最成功的娛樂產品之一。
